title: Top Wallets: Slim, Leather & RFID (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in more than one source (CNET and Gear43).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a commuter who wants a sleek, low‑profile wallet that holds up to eight cards. The Ekster Cardholder Pro offers an elegant design, a smooth mechanism, and a maximum of eight cards, making it ideal for everyday use. Its main catch is that it is a mechanical wallet, which may feel heavier than non‑mechanical options.
